a.speaker: harcourt
a.text: All right... all right. You win. Tommy always said you were the one with nerve.

c.speaker: harcourt
c.text: I was there that night. Fire watch. They handed me an extinguisher with nothing in it and told me to stand where the camera could see me.

d.speaker: harcourt
d.text: That wasn't an accident, Cass. Somebody wanted the real take. No cut. No reset. And somebody has been paying to keep that reel buried ever since.

s1.speaker: cass
s1.text: Tell whoever bought the reel I'm done playing their part.

c2.speaker: narration
c2.text: The Polaroid in his hand: the whole crew grinning in front of the car. Tommy in the middle. One face scratched out so hard the pen went through.

c4.speaker: harcourt
c4.text: The one who signed the checks. You'll meet him. Everybody does, eventually. Usually on television.
